steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a single-stage reverse auction.
Provide the required event title so publishing can be tested.
Apply an available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for the line item.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave each clause mode as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop when the create screen shows the terms configuration saved

steps.note: Configure the two clauses as optional because no catalog step directly manages clause creation or the mandatory switch.
Add one QA vendor participant for the bid.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round as the invited vendor.
Confirm the first optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Confirm the second optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Submit the vendor's quote without accepting any optional terms.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's project page.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor's direct response on the auction stage.
